lines.zh: 我披着破甲，跑起来哐当响。
lines.en: My broken armor clatters with every step.
Headless, and still I know the road.
I trample the pumpkin vine; it snaps.

lines.zh: 四条短腿跑得比影子快。
lines.en: Four short legs outrun my own shadow.
Stick legs tap the flagstones, tick-tick.

lines.zh: 我沿着麦田边的小路走。
lines.en: I follow the path along the wheat field.
Two plates fell off; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我抱着战利品，走得很稳。
lines.en: Carrying my prize, I walk steady.

lines.zh: 干草从我的缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Hay leaks out through my seams.
I skirt the puddle; iron rusts.
A knight's stride is a measured thing.
I lead; my master trails behind.
I set the heads by my feet and count.
This one is a zombie's; the teeth remain.
I remember the taste of every head.
Eyeless, I listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 稻草从脖子里钻出来了。
lines.en: Straw pushes up out of my neck.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头今天有点软。
lines.en: My pumpkin head feels soft today.
I count to seven, then scatter them.
A familiar does not sleep, only waits.

lines.zh: 铁锈味和草味混在一起。
lines.en: Rust and hay smell mixed together.
I hear my master turning pages.
This room is too bright; I shrivel.

lines.zh: 头堆里最圆的那颗最好。
lines.en: The roundest head in the pile is best.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己活过几次。
lines.en: I cannot count how often I have died.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸只是干草的沙沙。
lines.en: My breathing is only hay rustling.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸脖子，那里空着。
lines.en: I touch my neck and find nothing there.

lines.zh: 我把僵尸头摆正，它缺了一颗牙。
lines.en: I set the zombie head upright; it is missing a tooth.

lines.zh: 屋角的阴影里，有东西在看我。
lines.en: Something in the corner shadow is watching me.

lines.zh: 我把断了的木棍接了回去。
lines.en: I fit the broken stick back together.
You are taller; I tilt my pumpkin up.
Your head looks like a decent fit.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脖子看很久。
lines.en: I stare at your neck for a long while.
Do not fear: I only look, not take.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的生物的味道。
lines.en: You carry the scent of other creatures.
I raise my severed neck in salute.
Have you counted the heads at my feet?
I remember the sound of your boots.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝是空的，仍看你。
lines.en: My sockets are empty, and still I see you.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我数你的牙。
lines.en: When you laugh, I count your teeth.
My master said not to touch you; I resist.

lines.zh: 等你低头，我就要那颗头。
lines.en: Bow your head; I want what's on it.
A plate flies off; the hay scatters.
No pain, but I know to retreat.
You hit the pumpkin; it rings loudly.
I will remember this hand of yours.
One of my stick legs broke.
Below half, I come apart.
Not the neck; that is the loosest part.
The iron dented; my voice changed.
I can still hold, still hold.
Hay cannot plug this hole.
That stick could serve as my leg.
Wheat! The very smell of my body.
Lift that hay a little higher.
A pumpkin; I know that color.

lines.zh: 给我一根枝，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one twig and I will follow.
That is not for me, is it?
My buckle is loose; swap it for one.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，我一直想要。
lines.en: The hay in your hand is what I want.
I come close to sniff, not to bite.

lines.zh: 复活我的东西，就是这个。
lines.en: This is exactly what rebuilds me.
I bump your knee and back off half a step.
My plate scrapes across your trouser leg.
Do not step on me; I am lighter than I look.
The head I carry nearly fell.
Move aside; I need to pass the threshold.
A stick leg slips and hits you.

lines.zh: 我连头都没有，刹不住蹄。
lines.en: Headless as I am, my hooves won't brake.
Hay spilled everywhere; my apologies.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的头撞歪了。
lines.en: That knocked my head crooked.
My iron shoulder meets your waist.

lines.zh: 我不是活物，没有那种事。
lines.en: I am not alive; there is no such thing.
Familiars do not bear little familiars.
Seek a partner among real rats.
All I can multiply is hay.
This body was assembled, piece by piece.
I steal heads and give them all to my master.

lines.zh: 两颗南瓜碰在一起也会响。
lines.en: Two pumpkins knocked together make a sound.

lines.zh: 我的同类只在祭坛上出现。
lines.en: My kind appear only on the altar.

lines.zh: 召我的人才有权命令我。
lines.en: Only my summoner may order me.
For that, go find something living.
I cannot pick things up; I have no mouth.
I nudge it with my stump; that passes.
This head is mine; do not grab it.
I wobble when I carry anything.
What falls, I keep.
My iron hands are too small for big things.
I hide the pieces inside my hay.
I am keeping this tooth.
I pick up only what my master names.

lines.zh: 拿得动一件，就已经很多。
lines.en: One item is already a great deal.
That one has horns; I will remember.
My master dislikes your kind.

lines.zh: 你的头形不错，我先盯上。
lines.en: Your head shape is fine; you are first.
The target is set; I do not change it.
I smell the blood of your kin.

lines.zh: 这一族，我杀了不止一个。
lines.en: I have killed more than one of your family.
Your footsteps are enough to mark you.
I count your eyes to find the opening.
My master grows stronger because of you.
Your skull has collector's value.
Do not run; I can smell you.

lines.zh: 定下你了，断颈朝向的方向。
lines.en: You are chosen: the way my stump points.
I lower myself and tighten my plates.
I count the gaps between your steps.
There is a gap in your armor.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一步也不漏。
lines.en: I count your steps and miss none.
You step back; I take one step in.
I wait for your weight to shift.
I have practiced this cut a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我把刀横在稻草胸口，等你先动。
lines.en: I hold my blade across my straw chest and wait for you to move.
My shadow reaches your feet first.
Do not look at the heads by my feet.
Come; I let you move first.
I circle to your left, taking my time.
This one is for my head.
The iron blade crosses your knee's back.
The fallen all leave their heads.
I hit you with the whole of my armor.
A severed neck can still bite.
Weakened; your kind is weakened.
One cut, two cuts, that is enough.
The smell of your blood is new.
I keep this blow as a marker.
Do not rise; lying down is faster.
Wheat, stick, hay, and it is done.
I stand again — which time is this?
The pumpkin is set; now I can see.
The altar is still warm; I smell ash.
Who put me back together?

lines.zh: 我的断颈上还留着旧钉。
lines.en: Old nails still stud my severed neck.
Master, I have returned.
Hay twine tight, armor plates in place.
This time I may last a little longer.

lines.zh: 我的头颅放在哪个箱里？
lines.en: Which chest holds my head?
The soil has not settled; I stand first.

lines.zh: 复活很便宜，死得很轻易。
lines.en: Rebirth is cheap; dying comes easy.
Straw catches fire and it is over.
The fall scattered all my plates.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可我还是沉。
lines.en: I need no air, yet I still sink.
The blast opened my whole armor.
An arrow quivers in my pumpkin.
Magic on iron bites cold.

lines.zh: 使魔不吃东西，只是变轻。
lines.en: Familiars do not eat; we only grow light.
Lightning burned my hay to black thread.
In the void there are no heads to collect.
